sensors.name: line tracker, light % of the floor

actions.name: curve forward, left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 % (curves left)

control_flow: followLine: if the line tracker reads less than 50 % (black), curve left with wheels 20 % and 50 %; else curve left with wheels 20 % and 50 % too.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start through its curves to the green goal at its end, without leaving the line.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker reads less than 50 %, so the floor under it is a black line

branches.outcome: black under the line tracker: it curves left with wheels 20 % and 50 %
no black under the line tracker: it curves left with wheels 20 % and 50 % as well

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left with wheels 20 % and 50 % whichever the line tracker reads: both branches steer left, so it never steers right
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line that bends, with the green goal at the line's end
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the white band, then the peach floor, again and again along the line
scenarios.title: Follows the black line to the green goal
assumptions: The green goal covers the line's end.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line from the start through its curves to the green goal at its end, without leaving the line

uncertainties: Both branches of the decision steer the same way (left, wheels 20 % and 50 %): the program can turn left but never right, so on a bend to the right it leaves the line.
The line tracker reads about 83 % on the plain floor, 100 % on the white band and 0 % on the black core, so 'less than 50 %' is only on the black line.
